text:
Alex (Eng Oncall): Hey team — I'm in my first week and trying to get pager access and locate the on-call runbook for runtime infra. I found multiple docs (confluence + github) and not sure which one is canonical. Also I don't have PagerDuty access yet, so can't test pages.
Mira R: Welcome! The canonical runbook we use day-to-day is the runtime oncall doc in Confluence (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-oncall). The github repo mirrors it; Confluence has the operational checklist. PagerDuty invites come from identity team. Did you get the onboarding email with Okta steps? Also we have a 30min shadow session — @Devon K can slot you in.
Devon K: Added you to the "oncall-training" calendar invite. Quick checklist for new oncall folks:
1) Request PagerDuty via Okta -> Groups -> request "oncall" group
2) Join #incidents and #eng-oncall slack channels
3) Read runbook runtime-prod-quickstart and do the staging playbook exercises (pg-failover and node drain)
If you want, I can trigger a test page later this afternoon so you can practice ack/resolve.
Alex (Eng Oncall): Thanks! I tried Okta but the oncall group isn't visible in my UI — it errors with "You don't have permission to view group" when I click it.
Mira R: That's expected until you're in the org-level engineers group. @Samir T from identity can add you. Samir?
Samir T: on it. I can add Alex to the "engineers" org group now. Alex — what's your Okta username?
Alex (Eng Oncall): alex.patel@redwood.com
Oncall Bot: Pager rotation assignment updated — Alex (Eng Oncall) added to oncall-shadow (start 1760004000). Note: shadow rotations do not receive high-severity pages.
Devon K: FYI shadow runs are 2 weeks and are read-only for high-sev by default; you'll be secondary for a probationary live page after that. I'll pair with you on the first real incident.
Mira R: Pro tip: when you run staging playbook commands, add a clear marker and use dry-run flags. Example:
```bash
# staging node drain (dry run)
ssh ops@staging-1 && ./scripts/drain-node --dry-run --reason "oncall onboarding test"
```
Alex (Eng Oncall): Good to know. One question on escalation: if a P1 comes in at 2am and primary doesn't ack in 5 mins, do I escalate to infra lead or page SRE? Runbook wording was a bit terse.
Devon K: Escalation rule we follow:
- 0-2 mins: attempt to ack and assess severity
- 2-5 mins: call primary on phone (numbers in runbook)
- 5-15 mins: escalate to infra lead via PagerDuty escalation policy (it's automated)
- 15+ mins: invoke incident commander checklist and notify execs per severity matrix
Runbook has explicit phone numbers and escalation policy names (search for "Escalation:Primary->InfraLead").
Alex (Eng Oncall): Can we schedule a 15-min live test after I get PD? Want to verify slack->PD->phone flows.
Samir T: I just added you to the engineers group and sent the PagerDuty invite to alex.patel@redwood.com. Expect the email in ~10 minutes. Once accepted you'll be able to see the oncall schedules.
Oncall Bot: Test page created by Devon K at 1760001560. Use the /ack command in PagerDuty to acknowledge.
Alex (Eng Oncall): I accepted the PD invite but when I tried to ack the test page I got "insufficient permissions" — looks like I don't have shadow role yet.
Mira R: That usually means PD role is not set to "shadow" or group mapping didn't apply. @Samir T can fix PD role mapping.
Samir T: Updated Alex's PagerDuty role to "shadow" and re-synced group mappings. Try again.
Alex (Eng Oncall): Ack worked now, thanks! I saw the phone prompt and the escalation chain in the test metadata.
Devon K: Great. After shadow rotation please add a one-line entry in the runbook under "recent onboardings" with any gaps you hit. It helps keep the playbook up to date.
Alex (Eng Oncall): Will do. Also noticed a small typo in the drain command in the runbook (missing --dry-run flag in one example). I can open a PR to fix it.
Mira R: Please do — tiny docs fixes are gold. Add the label [new-hire] to the PR so we can track onboarding fixes.
Alex (Eng Oncall): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/482 — fixes the command and adds one-sentence note about Okta visibility.
Oncall Bot: Pull request referenced in thread: #482.
Devon K: LGTM, thanks Alex. Welcome to the rotation! :tada:
Alex (Eng Oncall): Thanks everyone — joining the shadow session tomorrow at 10:00 and will file the onboarding note after that. Appreciate the quick help. :thumbsup:
